thread:
morgan: ok small vote: do we want an official office stamp? 🤔
diego: absolutely yes. for validating sandwiches and good vibes.
lex: yes but it must say 'Approved by The Ink Stamp Guild' or i'm out.
ops-bot: Reminder: physical office supplies should be logged in the Supplies spreadsheet.
morgan: of course, i'll add it. proposing a tiny rubber stamp with a llama and a tiny crown.
kiki: llama is non-negotiable. are we also making initiation rituals?
diego: initiation is simple: present a snack, get stamped. we honor both salty and sweet.
lex: can we have different ink colors for different categories? green = caffeine, purple = celebratory cookies, orange = salad remorse.
snack-bot: :chip: snack-bot endorses. will print a weekly stamp leaderboard.
morgan: i made a mockup: https://imgur.com/mock-stamp (placeholder)
lex: love it. also want a secret handshake to go with the stamp. it involves three dramatic finger snaps.
diego: the guild shall convene at 3:14pm by the condiment shelf for the first stamping ceremony. attendance optional but snacks mandatory.
ops-bot: Please ensure stamp is stored in Supplies cabinet #2 when not in use.
kiki: i will bring an archival tupperware for stamp protection. we must preserve stamp integrity.
morgan: naming poll: "Ink Stamp Guild" vs "Order of the Llama Stamp". vote with emoji: :one: for ISG, :two: for OLS
lex: :two: (Order of the Llama Stamp aka OLS)
diego: :two:
kiki: :two: winner winner llama dinner.
snack-bot: :trophy: ceremonial inaugural stamp scheduled for 15:14. please RSVP by reacting.
morgan: also, small governance note: stamping is consensual. do not stamp someone's laptop without permission.
lex: rule added. unauthorized stamping = court-mandated coffee for a week.
diego: i'm making tiny membership cards with a stamped corner. swipe for discounts at the snack drawer (honor system).
ops-bot: FYI — no personal discounts on company-paid catering. guild must respect procurement rules.
kiki: less rules, more stamps. see you at the condiment shelf. long live the llama. :llama:
morgan: long live the llama. stamping ceremony photos will be posted in #random-pics after 15:30.
